title: Murder on the Midnight Express Liner
motive: Unpaid maritime gambling debts and contested shipping lane rights.

timeline.event: High-stakes poker game in the VIP saloon.
Captain Vance leaves poker table after a heated argument.
Steward finds Vance dead in his cabin.

dialogue_placeholders.suspect_010: He owed me half the expedition profits!
dialogue_placeholders.suspect_011: Vance was down 5,000 pounds when he stormed out.
dialogue_placeholders.suspect_013: I posted guards at the upper deck hatch as ordered.
dialogue_placeholders.suspect_019: Business competition is tough, but I don't bludgeon men.
